★ SIMPLE MACHINE #1: THE LEVER · IN YOUR NOTEBOOK
All 3 seesaws are balanced. Why?
10 minutes
Fulcrum = where it turns
Load = the weight you move
Effort = the force you use
Seesaw 1
30 kg at 2 m · 30 kg at 2 m
Seesaw 2
60 kg at 1 m · 30 kg at 2 m
Seesaw 3
45 kg at 2 m · 30 kg at 3 m
Multiply kg × m on each side of every seesaw. What rule do you discover?
★ SO… A SEESAW IS A SIMPLE MACHINE
Simple machines change the size or direction of a force
Lever
A bar that turns on a fulcrum. Like a seesaw.
Wheel and axle
A wheel fixed to a rod. They turn together.
Pulley
A wheel with a rope. Pull down to lift up.
Inclined plane
A ramp. Less force, but a longer path.
★ SIMPLE + SIMPLE + MOTOR =
A complex machine
1
Motor: gives the energy (input)
2
Wheel and axle: turns the ride
3
Gondolas: carry the people
4
Brake: controls and stops it
If one part fails, the whole ride stops. Parts working together = a system.
